profile.headline: Software Developer at HumRRO

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Conduct weekly sessions in which children are guided through programming concepts, preparing them to progress through the program set up by Coder Dojo.

positions.title: Chronograph: iOS App for better commutes
positions.description: Built a destination based alarm clock using Swift to create an iOS application as part of a team. Responsible for work on Routes tab, which displayed all route information, as well as mapping user movement and drawing the destination path. Utilized BartAPI for route data and Google’s Directions API to find distance between locations.

positions.title: Key Account Management System
positions.description: Partnered with local insurance company, Capital Insurance Group, to develop a web application to track special accounts that would replace their current system of tracking through excel spreadsheet. Handled work on the user interface of the web application, this includes work on three separate pages. Both the Lookup and Account Information pages required use of an API, created by fellow team members, in order to pass through data for creation of policies or accounts in database. Utilized React, React Router, Bootstrap, and Express.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Refactored one of Intel’s internal tools, Spec2Cpp, which automatically generates source code in C++ but was out of date and no longer functional. Work on tool resulted in four functioning filters. Development on Spec2Cpp included altering parsing methods in Python scripts to accommodate changes in third-party tools being used, updating template file to fix syntax and formatting errors, and editing BXml files to adapt to updates in hardware. Utilized Python, Mako templates, and BXml to carry out updates.

positions.title: Hack4Diversity
positions.description: Participated in Code2040's annual Hack4Diversity hackathon hosted at Univision. Along with three other Code2040 fellows, created a website that would generate a company's ethnic and gender pie charts using Google's Chart API as well as retrieve information from Glassdoor's API for the company's culture rating. The purpose of this project was to collect and present the data so that job seekers are informed to make decisions on which companies they'd like to apply for.

positions.title: Note It: An online list maker
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a list making web application which allows users to store, update, and delete
items on their list. User is also allowed to sort by recently deleted and added items. Utilized PHP and phpMyAdmin to store and retrieve user data into/from a database. Created user interface with HTML/CSS and Bootstrap.

positions.title: Peer Lead Team Learning (PLTL) Leader
positions.description: Lead group of students through weekly C++ exercises designed to strengthen fundamental computer science concepts, team building exercises, and critical thinking problems

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentored students between the ages of 13 to 60 in a one-day hackathon organized and hosted by herScript. Students with little to no previous programming experience created their own app using MIT App Inventor.
Provided customer service to visitors of the Salinas Valley Memorial Hospital gift shop. Activities included working cashier, closing out, cleaning gift shop, and organizing and restocking.

projects.title: Single Level Frogger (C++ game)
projects.description: My team and I worked together to recreate the first level of the classic arcade game, Frogger. For the development of this project I used C++ and the SFML Library. One of my roles for this project was coding the foundation for the sprites and basic sprite movement. Two others were establishing screen boundaries to keep sprites within the screen as well as design and create start / game over screens. Finally, I was also in charge of incorporating audio at specific times during gameplay, which was accomplished with the Music and Sound classes of SFML.

projects.title: Pest Begone!
projects.description: Directed a team of two in creating an image manipulation program that removes unwanted passersby from a batch of images using Python. Developed an algorithm that takes in nine images, finds the median pixel values, and uses these to construct an image with any obstructions to the main subject removed.

organizations.name: Code2040 Technical Applicant Prep/ Teach the Trainer Outreach Program
organizations.description: Encourage representation and inclusion of Blacks and Latinx in the tech industry by promoting racial diversity through outreach workshops for college students. Educate them about career opportunities in technology.

organizations.name: herScript
organizations.description: herScript is a women's Computer Science academic success program. It is a student-run non-profit organization at Hartnell College that strives to build exceptional women in technology through the development of professional and technical skills. herScript envisions a community of leaders and innovators in the Computer Science industry. There is an ongoing regime of harboring involvement within our community so that we may build more bridges that lead to Computer Science. (Website: herScript.org)
